request: Analyze GSE296683 for PMID 40832111 (Tomatidine Attenuates Inflammatory Responses to Exercise-Like Stimulation in Donor-derived Skeletal Muscle Myobundles.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq (Illumina, STAR + RSEM) of 3D donor-derived human myobundles (S2.6.p1)
final.sample_inclusion: 12 myobundle chips, all electrically stimulated (E-Stim, 3 V/mm, 2 ms, 2 Hz, 2x30 min/day, days 14-21): Young active (YA) vehicle n=3, YA tomatidine n=3, Old sedentary (OS) vehicle n=3, OS tomatidine n=3 (Table 1; S2.5.p1; S3.1.p1)

stimulation: E-Stim only; no unstimulated RNA-seq arm

final.primary_estimand: Effect of tomatidine vs vehicle on gene expression in E-Stim myobundles, separately within YA- and OS-derived myobundles (S2.7.p1; S3.2.p1). The paper's RNA-seq does not estimate the effect of exercise-like stimulation itself: every sequenced sample was stimulated.
planned_contrasts: YA tomatidine vs YA vehicle, both E-Stim (S3.2.p1; paper: 215 up / 219 down = 434 DEGs)
OS tomatidine vs OS vehicle, both E-Stim (S3.2.p1; paper: 12 up / 2 down = 14 DEGs)
final.repeated_measure_unit: none; each chip is one independent myobundle; donor cell lines pooled per cohort (one YA and one OS donor source)
final.normalization: RSEM gene quantification; low average counts excluded (S2.6.p1)
final.paper_method: DESeq2 on RSEM counts, tomatidine vs matched control per cohort (S2.6.p1; S2.7.p1)
final.paper_results: YA 215 up / 219 down; OS 12 up / 2 down; GSEA KEGG JAK/STAT; IL6 ~5-fold and CXCL8 ~1.6-fold up in YA tomatidine (S3.2.p1, S3.2.p3)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.6.p1 gives the pipeline (STAR, RSEM, DESeq2, FDR 0.05 and 2.0-fold change). S2.7.p1 and S3.2.p1 define the DE contrasts as tomatidine vs matched E-Stim control within each cohort. Table 1 lists 12 samples, all 'Young E-Stim' or 'Old E-Stim'. S3.1.p2 mentions unstimulated myotubes only for contractility displacement, not for RNA-seq.

checks: GEO series has 12 samples matching Table 1 (4 groups x 3)
organism Homo sapiens, tissue muscle, CD56+ myoblasts
matrix has 12 sample columns whose names equal the GEO library names

ownership.reasoning: Data availability statement S2.9.p1 names GSE296683; sample count and group structure match Table 1.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns are '<library name>.genes.results'; GEO description holds 'Library name: <library name>'. Exact match after stripping the suffix and prefix. cohort and trt come from the treatment characteristic ('YA control ( EStim)' etc.).

matrix.reasoning: GEO data_processing: 'tab-delimited matrix file, containing non-normalized FPKM values for all genes'; file name genes.fpkm.tsv.gz; values non-integer in 31% of cells. The paper ran DESeq2 on RSEM counts, which are not deposited, so the paper's method could not be reproduced exactly on this matrix (DESeq2 on FPKM is invalid).

design.stop_reason: No exercise contrast is identifiable. All 12 sequenced myobundles received exercise-like E-Stim (Table 1; GEO treatment field '( EStim)' on every sample); there is no unstimulated or pre-stimulation arm. The data support only tomatidine vs vehicle under E-Stim (a drug effect) and YA vs OS (donor age/activity, one donor source per cohort, aliased with donor), neither of which is an effect of exercise.
design.reasoning: The request asks how exercise affects gene expression. The paper's RNA-seq estimand is tomatidine vs vehicle within stimulated myobundles (S2.7.p1, S3.2.p1); stimulation is held constant. Candidate alternatives rejected: (1) trt tomatidine vs vehicle within cohort: analyzable but a pharmacological contrast, not exercise; (2) cohort OS vs YA: donor age/activity status confounded with the single donor cell source, not an exercise intervention, and not a paper DE contrast; (3) tomatidine x cohort interaction: not exercise. Small n is not the reason for stopping.

candidates.reason_rejected: drug effect under constant E-Stim, not an exercise effect
donor age/activity, aliased with donor cell source; not an exercise contrast and not reported by the paper

discrepancies.data: only an FPKM matrix is deposited
discrepancies.disposition: would require a declared deviation (limma on log2(FPKM+1)); moot because the case is refused at design

discrepancies.paper: exercise-like E-Stim applied to every sequenced sample; DE contrasts are tomatidine vs vehicle
